fields.title: Datasprings — Data Automation & API Platform
fields.short_summary: Django + Neo4j employment platform with scraping pipelines, RAG-based search, and cloud-native deployment.
fields.long_description: A production data aggregation and verification platform serving the employment space. I owned backend architecture, API design, deployment, and ongoing operations.
fields.tech_list: Django, Python, PostgreSQL, Neo4j, AWS Neptune, AWS EC2, AWS S3, AWS Lambda, Nginx, uWSGI, Selenium, BeautifulSoup, RAG
fields.problem: The employment data space is fragmented — dozens of sources, inconsistent formats, stale records, and no trustworthy verification layer. Recruiters and platform users were blocked on slow, manual reconciliation.
fields.approach: Designed a Django monolith that orchestrates scraping, normalization, verification, and graph-backed search. Built Selenium + BeautifulSoup pipelines feeding a cleaning/validation layer before writing to PostgreSQL for relational data and Neo4j / AWS Neptune for relationship queries. Wrapped everything in a REST API with JWT + SSO. Added a Retrieval-Augmented Generation layer over Bedrock so users get semantic answers instead of keyword hits. Deployed on EC2 behind Nginx + uWSGI with S3 for blobs, Lambda for async work, CloudWatch for observability.
fields.outcome: Shipped a platform that replaced manual workflows and is now the team's source of truth. Owned every on-call incident solo — kept uptime stable while shipping new features in parallel.
fields.metrics:
Zero-downtime deploys across 12+ production releases
Replaced ~70% of manual verification work with automation
Sub-second semantic search over the graph
End-to-end ownership of 3+ parallel systems

fields.title: AI-Driven Workflow Engine
fields.short_summary: RAG + LLM orchestration layer that turns repetitive ops work into automated, reviewable decisions.
fields.long_description: An internal workflow engine that wraps LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, AWS Bedrock) with guardrails, structured output, and vector-store retrieval to automate content generation, data enrichment, and decision support.
fields.tech_list: Python, Django, AWS Bedrock, Claude, ChatGPT, Vector DB, RAG, FAISS, PostgreSQL, Celery
fields.problem: Teams were losing hours to repetitive triage, data enrichment, and document-writing tasks. Off-the-shelf LLM tooling either hallucinated or couldn't ground on internal data.
fields.approach: Built a Django-native workflow engine around a RAG pipeline: chunk + embed internal documents into a vector store, retrieve top-k on each prompt, hand the LLM grounded context with explicit JSON schemas. Routed between Claude, ChatGPT, and Bedrock per task cost/latency. Added an audit log so every AI decision is reviewable. Structured output validation before anything writes back to the DB.
fields.outcome: Replaced multiple manual workflows while keeping humans in the loop where it matters. Cut average task turnaround materially while preserving traceability.
fields.metrics:
Grounded answers — no orphan hallucinations in production
Full audit trail for every AI-generated artifact
Multi-model routing (Claude / ChatGPT / Bedrock)
Retrieval latency under 200ms p95

fields.title: Timepaq — Attendance & Employee Management
fields.short_summary: Web-based attendance and HR system with biometric-device integration. Led design, delivery, and team coordination.
fields.long_description: A web platform that unifies biometric attendance capture with employee lifecycle management. I led the project — architecture, requirements, delivery — while coordinating the development team and directing the use of Claude Code for implementation.
fields.tech_list: Django, Python, PostgreSQL, Biometric SDK, React, REST APIs, Nginx, Linux
fields.problem: HR operations for distributed sites were split across biometric hardware, spreadsheets, and ad-hoc portals. Payroll reconciliation and attendance dispute resolution were painful.
fields.approach: Scoped the system end-to-end with stakeholders, designed the architecture, then ran delivery with a small team — directing Claude Code for implementation while owning code review, quality, and architectural alignment. Integrated biometric devices over their native SDKs, normalized events into a clean attendance model, built admin dashboards and REST APIs for downstream payroll tools.
fields.outcome: Delivered a production-ready platform without being the primary code contributor — focused on architecture, quality, and integration. Deployed and stabilized; handed off clean handover docs.
fields.metrics:
Led a team through end-to-end delivery
Integrated real biometric hardware without downtime
Architecture + quality ownership, not line-count ownership
Clean handoff — production support handed off cleanly
